description: Implementation of internal dcigettext function, handling message catalog lookups, string conversions, and localization support in C.

methods.name: DCIGETTEXT
methods.description: Main function to retrieve localized message strings from message catalogs, handling plural forms and locale-specific directories.

methods.name: _nl_find_msg
methods.description: Locates a message string in a loaded message catalog, with optional character set conversion and plural handling.

methods.name: plural_lookup
methods.description: Selects the appropriate plural form of a message based on the number n.

methods.name: category_to_name
methods.description: Returns string representation of locale category (e.g., LC_TIME).

methods.name: guess_category_value
methods.description: Guesses the current locale setting for a given category based on environment variables.

methods.name: stpcpy
methods.description: Copies string and returns pointer to the end, used if not provided by standard library.

methods.name: mempcpy
methods.description: Copies memory and returns pointer to the end, used if not provided by standard library.
